comparison.subtitle: See exactly what's included in each plan.

faqs.q: Can I switch plans at any time?
faqs.a: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. When upgrading, you'll be charged the prorated difference. When downgrading, the new rate takes effect at your next billing cycle.
Each connected social account counts as one channel. For example, one Facebook Page, one Instagram Business account, and one TikTok account would be 3 channels.

faqs.q: What counts as a media upload?
faqs.a: Each image or video file uploaded to a workspace counts as one media upload against your monthly quota. Reusing an already-uploaded file across multiple posts does not count again. See the comparison table for monthly limits per plan.

faqs.q: What happens when I hit my media upload limit?
faqs.a: You can continue publishing posts that use media already in your workspace — only new uploads are blocked. Your media upload quota resets at the start of each billing cycle, and you can upgrade your plan at any time for a higher quota.

faqs.q: How does the free trial work?
faqs.a: Every plan — monthly and annual — includes a {trialDays}-day free trial. Your card is collected at signup but won't be charged until the trial ends. Cancel anytime during the trial and pay nothing.

faqs.q: Which plans include the free trial?
faqs.a: All plans (Starter, Pro, Business) on both monthly and annual billing include the {trialDays}-day free trial. Annual billing also saves you 18% compared to monthly.

faqs.q: Can my AI agent or my own software use Markaestro?
faqs.a: Yes, on every plan at no extra cost. Any workspace admin can mint API keys from Settings → API and hand one to an AI agent, a script, or an off-the-shelf scheduling tool. Each key is bound to a single brand, carries only the scopes you tick, and can be given an expiry. See the AI agent guide for the tool definitions and a working four-command quickstart.

faqs.q: Do you offer discounts for nonprofits or startups?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer 50% off for verified nonprofits and early-stage startups (under $1M revenue). Contact us to apply.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex). Enterprise plans can pay by invoice.
